//: Typecheck config for the capture app's DOMAIN/PURE UNIT TESTS.
SEPARATE FROM tsconfig.app.json ON PURPOSE. The two have genuinely
different requirements, so folding them together would weaken both:
* tsconfig.app.json typechecks the APP. It must resolve `gi://*` and
`ags/gtk4` through @girs/ and must therefore NOT see node:test.
* this file typechecks the TESTS. It needs @types/node for
`node:test`/`node:assert`, and `allowImportingTsExtensions` because the
test files import the modules with an explicit `.ts` suffix.
WHERE @types/node COMES FROM: `make test-deps` installs it into this
directory's own node_modules on demand, exactly as it installs typescript
at the repo root. `"types": ["node"]` is a DECLARED dependency, not a
request for something the machine happens to have. The install MUST stay
under tests/ and out of the app tree: this directory is BELOW the app
config's own directory, so the default typeRoots walk from the repo root
never reaches it. tests/node_modules/ is gitignored.
Why the explicit `.ts` suffix: Node runs these files natively via its
built-in TypeScript type-stripping. Node's ESM resolver does NOT do
extensionless lookup, so the suffix is load-bearing. `tests/ts/resolve-hooks.mjs`
teaches the test runner the one extensionless resolution the app bundler
already does, for the app's own extensionless imports.
`noEmit` is set, and `rewriteRelativeImportExtensions` is deliberately NOT
used: nothing here is ever emitted.
